newsitem.title: USA: FP&L reports transmission line problems.
newsitem.headline: FP&L reports transmission line problems.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co reported power interruptions to some of its customers due to problems with high-voltage transmission lines.

"Customers in southeast Florida are experiencing brief power interruptions resulting from a rapid, unusual buildup of salt spray and dirt on the insulators of major transmission lines," the company said Thursday in a statement.
The company blamed the buildup on strong onshore winds last week that blew salt spray and dirt from beaches onto the lines, causing them to short circuit when moistened by dew or fog.
The company said most of the interruptions Thursday were to customers in Palm Beach and Martin counties.

"Although FP&L is implementing measures to minimize the interruptions, the unusual conditions along the Atlantic Coast counties may continue until heavy rains wash away the buildup," the utility said.
Weather Services Corp's latest forecast calls for normal to slightly below normal precipitation in Florida over the next 10 days.
